dedupe_keys.name: open elyas renewable energy time series and potentials for europe hydro run of river wind and pv 2018

description: Open ELYAS is a pair of data sets giving renewable power capacity factors and capacities for 2018, calculated with the Energy Data Analysis Tool EnDAT, which was started at the German Aerospace Center (DLR) and extended for this publication. Both were published on Zenodo in June 2026 by Jonas Straub, Yvonne Scholz, Kim Cholibois, Manuel Wetzel, Madhura Yeligeti, Wenxuan Hu and Kai von Krbek within the ELYAS project, funded by the German economy ministry BMWK. The hydro set gives 6-hourly capacity factors and installed capacities for run-of-river plants, built from JRC, WRI and GloHydroRes plant lists matched to HydroRIVERS and driven by EFAS river discharge. The wind and PV set gives hourly capacity factors and installable capacities for three onshore wind classes, fixed and floating offshore wind, rooftop PV and four open-area PV mounting types, using land cover, bathymetry, protected areas and the Global Wind Atlas. Coverage is European regions at NUTS 3 level. Files are CSV with Open Energy Metadata JSON, about 22 MB for hydro and several GB for wind and PV, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY-SA 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: only the weather year 2018 is given, and results are regional aggregates, not plant-level. Simulation uses are renewable supply inputs for European capacity expansion and dispatch models and low-water hydro studies. Related records: data-glohydrores-global-hydropower-reservoirs is an input plant data set.
